text:
ema: Heads-up — rolling deploy tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC for multi-shard schema change (tenant_shard_id PK swap + backfill). Need ops + oncall coverage and a clear quiesce/handback plan.

maria: +1. Plan I put together: 1) Add nullable new pk column `tenant_shard_id_v2` (no lock), 2) Start backfill workers with shard-aware rate limiting (10 shards parallel, 5s shard pause), 3) Once backfill <1% errors/latency stable for 10m, schedule 30s exclusive PK-swap per shard with coordinated lease handback.

lucas: Suggest adding explicit pausepoints between phases so we can abort after step 2 without taking locks. e.g. `deploybot holdpoint: backfill-complete`.

ema: yes — we'll set two holdpoints: after `schema-add` and after `backfill-run`. deploy-bot will enforce. Also pin frontend/runtime version to `v1.12.3` during cutover.

deploy-bot: [automated] Scheduled: deploy set for 1767891234 (root) — holdpoints: schema-add, backfill-complete. Canary: 10%.

maria: Preflight checks ran on staging, snippet: 
```
ok: create column tenant_shard_id_v2 NULL
ok: migration id=2025_05_12_add_tenant_shard_v2 applied
backfill_estimate: 3h @ unlimited; throttled to 45m at 10 shards
sample_row_check: 0 errors
```

maria: Note — PK-swap uses short exclusive table lock for `ALTER TABLE .. DROP/ADD CONSTRAINT` on each shard. We'll do separate transactions per shard, target <=30s lock. We'll also run `pg_stat_activity` guard.

sre-oncall: I'll add paging rules if lock time >45s or error rate >5% for a shard. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-ddl-cutover . I'll also add a dashboard: `infra.ddl.swap.latency` + `app.write-errors`.

lucas: Rollback hatch: if any shard fails to reach backfill <1% after 20m, abort job, revoke new column usages, and pin traffic back to read-only mode for migration tables. Also have we decided on the feature flag name?

ema: feature flag: `tenant_shard_v2_enabled` — rollout off by default, turned on after all shards swapped + 10m stability. Rollback path: deploy-bot will pin model to `v1.12.3` and we run backfill cancel script: `scripts/backfill_cancel.sh --run-id $RID`.

devops-bot: Canary started on staging at 1767891300: 10% traffic, no errors so far. Logs: `backfill: 0 error / 1200 rows/s`

maria: One more thing — plan for lease handback: we'll acquire application-level lease via `/lease/ddl-swap/shard-$N` with TTL 90s. If a node fails to release, ops will force-release via `kubectl exec` helper.

ema: Okay — action items: @maria preflight & ensure backfill_cancel exists; @lucas add holdpoints to the release config; @sre-oncall add alert thresholds and standby pager; I'll draft short release notes and pin the runtime version. If no objections, we'll proceed with the window. :thumbsup:

lucas: I'll add the holdpoints now.

sre-oncall: Standby from 01:45-03:30 UTC, will escalate if alerts fire.

deploy-bot: [automated] Holdpoint reached: `schema-add` — waiting for human approval.

ema: Approving holdpoint. Proceed to backfill.

maria: Backfill started on prod canaries (shard 0-9). Monitoring closely.

devops-bot: Canary progress: shard 0..4 complete, shard 5..9 running. avg backfill latency 120ms, error rate 0.3%.

lucas: If anything spikes, we abort and run `scripts/backfill_cancel.sh`. Keep logs handy.

ema: Good. I'll post release notes to #announcements before the exclusive PK swaps. Short notes: "DB: add tenant_shard_id_v2 column, backfill, PK swap per shard. Feature flag off until stable. No user-visible changes expected."

sre-oncall: Copy that. Ready to escalate.

maria: ETA for beginning per-shard PK-swap: 02:40 UTC. I'll call out when each shard lock is about to be taken.

ema: Perfect — thanks everyone.
